channel.title: AI Threat Watch: HK
channel.description: Verified case files located in HK.

item.title: [HIGH] HKU law student accused of making 700+ AI porn images of 20-30 women, including classmates and teachers
item.description: Three accusers said a University of Hong Kong law student used AI to make more than 700 indecent images of 20 to 30 women, including classmates and secondary school teachers, which a peer found on his laptop in February 2025. HKU's warning letter drew public outrage, and Hong Kong's privacy commissioner opened a criminal investigation. Target: Women including University of Hong Kong classmates, friends and secondary school teachers. HK. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Hong Kong police arrest 22 who used AI face-swaps on lost ID cards to open bank accounts
item.description: A syndicate pasted members' faces onto photos from lost Hong Kong ID cards to pass remote onboarding at seven banks, opening 19 accounts that laundered about HK$190 million; 22 people were arrested. Target: Seven Hong Kong banks and stored-value facilities. HK. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Hong Kong police arrest 31 in Kowloon Bay deepfake romance-crypto syndicate (HK$34M)
item.description: Hong Kong's Commercial Crime Bureau arrested 31 people in Kowloon Bay who used AI face-swapped personas on dating apps to lure overseas victims into fake crypto platforms, taking over HK$34 million (about $4.37M). Target: Dating-app users in Taiwan, Singapore, Malaysia and the US. HK. Verification: confirmed.
